summary: All T14 recurrence semantics acceptance criteria verified: supported series round-trips as one UID/resource, modified and deleted occurrences persist, unsupported RRULE fails with 400, and ETags are deterministic.
important_context: Supported RRULE parts: FREQ (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL. BYDAY and other parts are rejected.
Recurrence exceptions stored in event_recurrence_exceptions table with is_deleted flag for EXDATE semantics.
The ICS parser validates RRULE via RecurrenceRule::parse which rejects unsupported parts explicitly.
